notes.title: Updates 1.01, 1.02, and 1.03 now LIVE!
notes.notes:

[*] Lots more!

For everything else, check out the Steam page news page [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/691790]HERE[/url]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.3
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Balance[/b][/h2]
[Cavalier]
[list]
[*] Removed equipment requirements for One-Handed Training and Two-Handed Training
[*] [One-Handed Training] - level 2 now bestows +2 ATK and +5 Critical Chance
[*] [Two-Handed Training] - level 2 now bestows +2 ATK and +5% Critical DMG
[*] Localization text now reflects these changes
[*] [Quicken] - level 2 now bestows +1 MOV and +1 SPD instead of +2 MOV to better balance Cav's new mobility
[/list]
[Skill Height Tolerance Changes]
[list]
[*] Reduced height tolerance for certain Ranger, Monk, Cavalier, and Sorcerer Skills so they no longer can be used with vast height differences between attacker and defender
[*] Skills affected: Sorcerer [Withering Touch, Lightning Touch, Frost Touch, Flame Touch], Monk [Martyr, Innumerable Blows, Blinding Spin], Cavalier [Sword Bash, Shield Triage, Shield Bash, Rend Armor, Quick Attack, Body Rush, Low Sweep, Adrenaline Strike], Ranger [Crossbow Attack, Bow Attack]
[/list]
[Unit HP Buff]
[list]
[*] All units have received a ~15-25% HP increase depending on level, with additional HP increases for certain boss units and monster units.
[/list]
[Shaman]
[list]
[*] [End Times] - Reduced End Times damage from 100% to 80% to account for it hitting all units on the battlefield regardless of Shaman position (but still can only be used once per battle and has high SP cost)
[/list]

[h2][b]Features[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Added language support for Simplified Chinese.
[*] Added support for Non-Pixel Fonts (Latin script languages only) - toggleable through accessibility settings in Options.
[*] Added ability to see skill descriptions from Core Class skills after advancing class in the Skill: Equip submenu.
[*] “Escape to Tile” missions and contracts now are considered victories when killing all enemies on the map.
[/list]

[h2][b]Script[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] The Japanese description of the Hunter’s Fire Trap should now list an accurate range.
[*] The English description of Rank 3 Ice Shard now correctly reads 115% instead of 15%.
[*] Fixed issue in which the UI localization for Russian was incorrect on the Overworld screen.
[/list]

[h2][b]Achievements[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Added additional check for “Crowning a New Ruler” achievement while loading the Title Screen.
[/list]

[h2][b]UI[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Polished and improved the text layout of UI elements all across the game.
[*] Added animation polish to most standard UI boxes.
[*] Streamlined menu flow in the Troop Manager > Contracts screen.
[*] The ability to see HP and SP above the heads of all units on the battlefield has been added. Hold down “Switch: Right” (on gamepad, right trigger) during most battle phases to access it. 
[*] The turn order overlay (accessed via “Help,” on gamepad the Select button) can now be triggered from more battle phases.
[/list]


[h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed screen tearing issues for high refresh rate monitors.
[*] Units dying from status effects like Burning and Noxious now correctly flinch before dying.
[*] Fixed bug in which the unit information panel would still remain going into the victory/defeat screen.
[*] An issue with the turn order overlay interacting unexpectedly with the Right Mouse button has been fixed.
[*] Fixed issue in which the UI would not correctly refresh the battle objectives and Action Menu after changing a language mid-battle.
[*] Removed the chance of turning oneself Undead as an Inquisitor with Shield Triage.
[*] “Target Unit” skill targeting type no longer mistakenly targets tiles under certain conditions.
[*] Fixed rare instance of Delayed Area-of-Effect skills failing to inflict the full zone of damage when the main target dies prematurely. 
[*] Fixed bug in which cutscenes could not progress when skipping through them too quickly.
[/list]

If you were wondering what all our Advanced Class highlights were building up to - wonder no more!

We're finally ready to reveal the official release date of Arcadian Atlas on Steam!

[h1]Release Date Reveal Trailer[/h1]
Why are you even reading still?! Click to watch the trailer you gorgeous people you!

[previewyoutube=j9ndtm4mI80;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/691790/Arcadian_Atlas/

[h1]Save The Date: July 27th, 2023[/h1]
After a wild ride together, Arcadian Atlas is officially launching on Steam July 27th and we couldn't be more excited to see our passion project in the hands of the people!

The story of Lucretia's struggle for the crown, Annalise's search for power in a world that's only marginalized her, and of course Vashti and Desmond's fight to hold onto each other - and their humanity - through it all have become so much more to us than the sum of its parts. notes.title: June 2023 Update
notes.notes:
Welcome back to another Arcadian Atlas update as we creep ever closer to release!

This month we have a sneak peak at our final advanced class: Reaver, along with some of the finishing touches as we draw closer to our Gold build!

[h1]Squashing Bugs and Picking Fonts[/h1]

As we near gold, we're doing some of the final stage polish and bug squishing, putting a fine sheen on everything and seeing it come to vivid life! A few of the highlights:

[h3]Bugs: [/h3] 
We're now up to 270 bugs squashed just in the last 2 months alone - Paddy has been fixing them as quickly as we can find them. A huge thanks to everyone who play tested builds at GDC, Pax East, and Steam Fest - your bug reports have been invaluable to finding and squishing those quickly!

[h3]Localization: [/h3] 
we've begun testing out some lovely fonts for Japanese, Chinese, and Russian fonts, as well as adding specialized characters to all our current fonts to ensure accent marks and other special characters are fully supported!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30578666/dedec38da4b4163fd27c7e37f81c40a365cdacbd.png[/img]

[h3]Achievements: [/h3] 
We've completed testing of achievement unlocks for all 40 unlockable achievements to ensure their triggers are all in place and functioning properly!

[h3]Polish:[/h3] 
And last but certainly not least, we've refined many aspects of the game including a revamp of the Title Screen and logos, with 29 tutorials, over 30 tavern chatter entries, over 80 cutscenes, and over 40 compendium entries - this is well and truly a labor of love come to life!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30578666/45d76bddbf0e881869f8d53edd630eb4bb024f4c.png[/img]

[h1]The Reaver[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30578666/c6c39839c76a8d4ab1311e66670f1260b28323d2.gif[/img] 

The Reaver lives their life in the shadows, mastering the art of one-on-one combat and quickly slinking back into stealth to survive another day. Those studied in the Dagger Arts tree have honed their reflexes with tiny blades, delivering a flurry of blows to deal status effects with every strike, while those of the Hired Assassin tree favor critical backstabs and recruiting the shadows to fight for them, leaving their foes broken both physically and mentally. 

[h2]Delaying Strike[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30578666/c6cf203f6a2d59da13ee2ed02c7e38733f827436.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30578666/6e185092be0aa7db44ddcf073eff96826c6158a8.png[/img]

Need to push a unit further back in the turn order to perfectly time a delayed skill? Delaying Strike does just that, while also dealing damage!

[h2]Heart Stop[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30578666/eebb933a8900e9baeb0694f50c7445f63dd17879.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30578666/2d3cfc0560bdbb84146607e8384b218ee8836efc.png[/img]

While it doesn't deal much damage, Heart Stop is guaranteed to inflict Stun Status on a foe, ensuring they miss their next turn.

[h2]Smoke Screen[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30578666/19d0538c3d372706805c13c986d1b626f41edf0b.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30578666/8093d1641670c6a48f75cb3c2c25b5fe33aba7cf.png[/img]

Not all traps are bad! The Reaver's Smoke Screen actually bestows a huge bonus to EVADE on any friendly units ending their turn in its radius.

[h2]Backstab[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30578666/ede4e39ef71f4ea76e24230dc0a3bd44e7c1d8ce.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30578666/2e6772e9468741ff57ba965a0a9fddccebb1ec9a.png[/img]

While the SP cost is high, Backstab is a hugely powerful skill guaranteed to critical against the Reaver's target.

[h3]Find the Latest on our Socials![/h3]

And don't forget to check out our socials for all the latest information, gifs, videos, and sneak peaks:

Instagram: @arcadianatlasgame 
Twitter: @ArcadianAtlas 
Discord: https://discord.gg/qtwN6Ve 
Website: www.arcadianatlas.com 
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/691790/Arcadian_Atlas/ 

We're nearing that shiny, shiny gold status and very excited to share even more as we get closer to that point. Stay tuned for more as we can reveal it, and thanks so much for following us on this journey!

- by Taylor Bair

notes.title: May 2023 Update
notes.notes:
(apologies for the slight delay, I lost track of time! - Becca)

It's that time again! Welcome to another monthly Arcadian Update!

This month we've got a new advanced class to show off in the Ronin, along with news on achievements and localization - so get your katanas at the ready and let's dive right in!

[h1]Achievements & Localization[/h1]

As we near completion on the gold build of Arcadian Atlas, we've turned our eye to all the bells and whistles that come along with game development.

[h1]Localization[/h1]

We've begun our localization search for the perfect translators to the Arcadian Atlas script - which is huge, running the gamut from cutscene dialogue, skill & item descriptions, tavern contracts, chatter, compendium entries, and tutorials.

We'll keep you all posted as we secure additional language translators so we can see the full spectrum of languages available upon launch - so stay tuned!

[h1]Achievements[/h1]

Who doesn't love a little recognition for their hard work!? That's why we're chipping away at some of the creatively implemented achievements to make sure not just story progress but also mastery of the skill and battle systems are rewarded. Find a sneak peak of some of the achievements below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30578666/97d9f060184ffb9d13aaed8f6a72c83fd1f3bbe8.png[/img]
[h3]"No Think, Only Smash"[/h3] - Inflict Rage on a single unit in battle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30578666/952b90ec7f4963992d6770a165e3ea87e6fafe1f.png[/img]
[h3]"Jack of All Trades"[/h3] - Learn all skills in a single skill tree in one playthrough.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30578666/96707d32225993a66fdd8b59bef24b0ea0473afc.png[/img]
[h3]"Created In Our Image"[/h3] - Respec any unique unit (Desmond, Vashti, Eda) using CMD Point rewards.

[h1]The Ronin[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30578666/a03a99e44cfa86340dc020daa47d92611486d5c1.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30578666/492025c9c1d04da6797e66b2680ee2bc2a66f898.gif[/img]

The Ronin is wholly aligned with honorable warriors of the past, harnessing their spirits in the Wandering Soul tree to bestow healing on allies and cripple foes while channeling the unrelenting rage of their time on the battlefield in their Battle Trance tree, losing all control for huge bonuses to ATK, Criticals, and self-preservation.

[h2]Possessing Spirit[/h2]

[previewyoutube=11Mq86Wl0yE;full][/previewyoutube]

Possessing Spirit is one of the few skills that inflicts Charm Status on a foe, turning them to your side for a brief period of time, while leaving the Ronin weakened as a trade-off.

[h2]Blade Blossom
[/h2]
[previewyoutube=MeI6zhUGggo;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: March 2023 Update
notes.notes:
Howdy once again you gorgeous people! 

It's a new month which means a new Arcadian Update, where we share new features, skills, maps, and everything Arcadian Atlas from the Twin Otter team! 
But let's not wait - we're diving on in!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/088/853/5709ca15a199e59ad2320bda3bf343ce_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1677611672&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=91f7b6a3e024ad4e0f83633a80217651[/img]
 
[h2]Steam Next Fest Improvements[/h2]

We wanted to extend a huge thank you to everyone who played the Arcadian Atlas demo for Steam Next Fest and provided a wealth of improvement ideas and bug reports!
It was truly a humbling experience seeing the outpouring of support from fans and newcomers alike, and we've been working away at all the feedback to ensure the game is even better! A sneak peak at what's in the works below:

[h2]The Heavens Roll In[/h2]

Many of you wanted to see a more vibrant, active world map - so we've listened! Now you'll find billowy clouds rolling in and a gentle breeze blowing across Arcadia! 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/088/898/d4d7dc7d2ca08257228580e23f54540a_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1677611887&gif-q=50&q=92&s=ab501ec6fe014f49a608c569aa0991c6[/img]
 
[h2]New Button Prompts[/h2]  

Want to know when more information is available on options, items, unit promotions and when you can undo movement? Look no further! We've been adding additional callouts for Undo Movement and More Info Boxes on top of existing skill tooltips to put more features at your fingertips 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/088/924/4b047260bae97b691d477ba917935f27_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1677612003&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=7a3c0d38a7df54a06778e83886c95db3[/img] 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/088/927/87593096de7d9283542f1d2fdba30791_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1677612024&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=8c3042ab42bfb6c61d531d1da23fd24c[/img] 

[h2]Bug Fixes Galore[/h2] 

We've gathered all the detailed bug reports from the countless demo players and already gotten to work squashing those pesky guys - a huge thanks to everyone who documented bugs for us!

[h2]New Key Art[/h2] 

We commissioned the extremely talented artist [url=https://www.jasmindarnell.com/]Jasmin Darnell [/url]to hand-craft some lovely new key art for the game. You’ll see this art on Steam and other sites as our MAIN advertising illustration from here on out. 

We’re extremely excited to present to you….  

[img]https://images-wixmp-ed30a86b8c4ca887773594c2.wixmp.com/f/7ef42496-348f-497a-920c-dfb6171be499/dfqk49a-dfa041e0-d862-4826-859d-9829c698a153.png?token=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..xXmqc7wnlI3QQ7XPhvgZRoF1ZVdSDRFKccvvqWmUNHM[/img]
 
Catch us online with this new advertising artwork from here on out!

[h2]The Monk[/h2] 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/088/957/a8fc19f9076404d76e6051ef68a57fcb_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1677612152&gif-q=50&q=92&s=8c93883d1238fe6527774a67a147da28[/img] [img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/088/959/59c7fada9e5e1df76a601adc0e67fdc7_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1677612167&gif-q=50&q=92&s=d7070c58d4de6189249729a2639a45db[/img]


The Monk, one of Apothecary's advanced jobs, has spent years rigorously training their body and pouring over books of the arcane, using their Furious Blows tree to strike so quickly and so often that they bypass DEF, only considering the MDEF of their foes and attempting to chain their skills endlessly one into another, while those of the Arcane Energies tree channel that energy into powerful bolts to heal or harm and alter time itself to haste allies or slow their foes.

[u][b]Arcane Bolts[/b][/u]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/089/000/f85e897641e873009d07e4111f7d7e79_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1677612300&gif-q=50&q=92&s=4e3b056f7c3dfefb637986a70e8ad846[/img] 

Arcane Bolts sends 4 bolts of pure, element-free energy towards the target, not only damaging them but guaranteed to inflict Slow Status, ensuring their turn is delayed in combat.

[b][u]Blinding Spin[/u][/b] 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/089/012/4e426078f2a5d408f8365a38e3731f07_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1677612333&gif-q=50&q=92&s=9cdc98fb56c982be970f42712c09c734[/img]

[u][b]Martyr[/b][/u] 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/089/028/07dd6aef6b79e674ae9a4df710c053c5_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1677612433&gif-q=50&q=92&s=2eec078074a677c932b956acb3015d6a[/img] 
 
A Monk's last - and most powerful - resort, Martyr deals the full Max HP value of the Monk to their foes, but leaves the monk completely drained, with only 1 HP and 1 SP remaining.

[url=https://www.instagram.com/arcadianatlasgame/][img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/089/036/6484fcaa78e1c2e4725028661458b1e7_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1677612483&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=b4b77ddb8caaa2b8c256bb283dae6b99[/img][/url]

Stay tuned for more in the coming months as we get ever closer to that Summer 2023 release - everything from contracts, secrets, more advanced classes, story sneak peaks and improvements!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/039/845/847/380e37791a9131114a66577f5249363e_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1675438405&gif-q=50&q=92&s=069de12b4581beb91631ee692d2ca702[/img]

There are tons of other Quality Of Life improvements and tweaks we've made based on your suggestions, so please continue to help us make this game the absolute best it can be!

[h3]Play It for Yourself[/h3]

We don’t want to give away everything now, so go experience the demo for yourself!

Feel free to stream/record your playthrough, you might even get a shout-out from us & our fans sent your way!

[h3]We’d Love Your Honest Feedback[/h3]
Once you get your hands on the demo, we’d love to know what you think! We are nearing the end of development on Arcadian Atlas and this will likely be the last chance for us to implement player feedback into the final game. Comment your thoughts about the demo on this update, tag us on social media, and feel free to stream your playthrough (we’ll be dropping by streams to see your reactions). Pop into our [url=https://discord.gg/qtwN6Ve]Discord [/url] and share your feedback in the #support channel, the team is looking forward to hearing from ya!

We can't wait to show off more Arcadian Atlas content in February! Stay tuned for more on our socials!

[h2]The Inquisitor[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30578666/338b0960b08309566232e1b6ccbccee88507e176.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30578666/113a06ee332fba86e27125350e600a47c6b1cd0d.gif[/img]
The Inquisitor is a mage killer. They sacrifice DEF to gain additional MDEF, getting in close to mages as quickly as possible and attempting to turn foes Undead, dispatching them with Holy Element damage and SP crippling skills while bestowing huge bonuses to their allies through Grand Auras. The Inquisitor uses the strength of their faith to fight back the darkness in the world. A true shining light, perfect for this holiday season.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30578666/0223c485aae34c3164d8872282c4d123061a2081.gif[/img]
[b]Silencing Ray[/b]
Silencing Ray deals damage and inflicts Silence. As a mage-killer, inflicting Silence and preventing magic use is a crucial tactic for the Inquisitor.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30578666/87da3f0d8dbe995f56de67ece2cbb7f04939ffee.gif[/img]
[b]Smiting Blow[/b]
This skill deals a large amount of HP Damage, but also damages a target's SP based on the Inquisitor's MDEF stat, helping to cripple magic users in two ways. The Inquisitor has many different ways of disarming magic users.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30578666/cc6382140ad28a1fac45c985ce1e465e1435fd0c.gif[/img]
[b]Grand Aura[/b]
Grand Aura increases both the MDEF and DEF stat of all friendly units within the trap area, and this effect persists for 2 turns and can be further modified by other skills to bestow even more benefits. In addition to crippling enemy mages, Inquisitors can also shield their party from enemy magic.

[h2]Happy New Year![/h2]

We hope everyone had a happy holiday season and we are wishing everyone a safe and successful new year! We deeply appreciate all of your support throughout Arcadian Atlas’ development and to celebrate the start of 2023 (our release year) we have a bonus skill and a nice surprise to show off as a special treat!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30578666/7b08a2026f00c549feb2078f923aba9b9bec888c.gif[/img]
[b]Rapture[/b]
Drop holy wrath on a foe to deal 110% Holy Element DMG with a 30% chance to inflict Stun Status. Cleanse the battlefield of your vile foes with this powerful Holy attack!

[b]Skill Tooltips[/b]
You might have already caught a glimpse of this new UI addition in the gifs included in this update, but we have added skill tooltips! Thanks to all of the valuable feedback we received from our PAX West demo, we have implemented a Skill Info Box that appears in the top left corner of the screen to describe what a skill does, along with a Skill Range display which will show you the range of a skill on the battlefield as you hover over it in the Action List.

notes.notes:
Hey there, folks! Welcome to Arcadian Updates, where we share super cool updates for Arcadian Atlas that the Twin Otter team are working on, including new maps, classes, mechanics, and much more! We'll have more to share as time goes on, so follow along and check it out!

[h2]Our Scariest Update Yet[/h2]
In honor of Spooky Season, this month’s update will focus on some of the more supernatural and sinister skills included in Arcadian Atlas! Prepare yourselves for some ghoulish sneak peeks!

[h2]The Shaman[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30578666/4191d96cd7d1491ce378a47a5c5ef37aceddeb26.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30578666/930b63a67c1f056bf1478ca2687ef742768c46bd.gif[/img]

The Shaman dabbled too long on the fringes and dark recesses of science, learning to manipulate the powers of life and death sometimes for good, and sometimes to the horror of all who witnessed. We already introduced the Shaman class back in February, but we didn’t touch on any of their advanced skills. Let’s take a look at their supernatural abilities below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30578666/758a769d479a0c7287edb2dbd6e7d2b00d7f5c6a.gif[/img]
[b]Nightmarish Vision[/b]
This skill puts a target to sleep and inflicts a myriad of negative Status Effects such as Wet, Limp, Fracture, and Blind. Pray that the Shaman is fighting on your side, as this skill is truly the stuff of nightmares for the Shaman’s enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30578666/51e2f54fe37c0ea457d2a2e9c8329ad748689833.gif[/img]
[b]Unholy Revival[/b]
Once per battle, this skill allows the Shaman to revive all unconscious allies with a small amount of HP, but completely drained of SP and Undead, meaning normal healing harms them. Raising allies as undead is both spooky and convenient!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30578666/9fba3a340dbd0f8b28b59445cbe2febf4b8d41c2.gif[/img]
[b]Blood Puppet[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30578666/94cf8e5e25a230dcbf9e8b2864a9514c860e8feb.gif[/img]

[h2]Advanced Skills[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30578666/97dbaf8cad437bfb35597fde86d37a6e8e8340ae.gif[/img]

[b]Fire Trap (Hunter Skill)[/b]
The Fire Trap skill is reserved for the Hunter Class. Using your owl companion, lay flame traps on the battlefield that persist for 3 turns, burning foes and allies that stop or start their turn on them. Additionally, the Hunter’s owl companion attacks an enemy whenever the Hunter attacks, making them both cute AND deadly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30578666/aeb8ca436539a1d9299e924fd41868be4f66b849.gif[/img]

[b]Second Skin (Reaver Skill)[/b]
The Reaver has the ability to generate a Second Skin. Create a shadowy skin for yourself, bestowing temporary HP for 5 turns that absorbs blows until depleted. This is a great defensive skill that can extend a Reaver’s time on the battlefield.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30578666/a32f39abde1a06c014d613410f5a8832f4697210.gif[/img]

The Ronin has skills that are deadly and others that are restorative, like Blade Blossom. Cherry blossoms blanket the battlefield, bestowing Regen status on all allies and healing them a small amount while delivering slow healing over time for 3 turns. This skill is perfect when you find yourself in a pinch and your allies are low on health.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30578666/74790851b9053a5d30b12d1890ca52b51ebb723b.png[/img]

Each Advanced Class will have two branching skill trees to allow for increased strategic customization of units. The Ronin features the Wandering Soul tree and the Trance Arts tree. Under the Wandering Soul tree, Ronin units can harness the spirits of their warrior ancestors and bestow healing on their allies while crippling their foes. The Trance Arts tree focuses the rage of fallen warriors into powerful attacks and modifiers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30578666/1c090c2988ceb5c75182ce3827d135d17b144793.gif[/img]

Today, we're sharing a very first look into one of the sub-classes of [i]Arcadian Atlas[/i]: [b]The Hunter[/b]! Master the art of stealth, lay traps on the battlefield, and rain arrows on your enemies!

The Hunter knows that man’s greatest foe is one that strikes from above, catching them unawares. With their Death From Above tree, the Hunter and their Animal Companion rain deadly strikes from the skies, while the Guerrilla Tactics tree turns the battlefield into a minefield, laying traps and making foes regret ever stepping foot into Hunter territory.

The Hunter sticks to the shadows, preferring Guerilla Tactics over direct conflict. Use [b]Reconnaissance[/b] to gain a better vantage of the battlefield before laying any manner of elemental trap on the battlefield. Let loose your arrows to rain death from above with [b]Comet Shot[/b], striking up to three enemies at once. Maximize pain at nerve centers in order to increase Critical Damage, allowing for fatal blows. Equip a bow or crossbow for varying levels of damage and strike fear in the hearts of your opponents from the shadows.

[h2]Lundum Hills[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30578666/d50bdd31da9fac8c93ff50fb0357bf0d025b2cba.png[/img]

Not all is right with the world, and less so in recent memory. Crazed soldiers often return home and speak of ghastly creatures yet unheard of in Arcadia. Beasts of incredible power, the dead rising from their graves, terrible monstrosities in the skies. Dire tales of this land spread on hushed whispers, sowing fear and skepticism among all whose ears they reach.

They're too ridiculous to be believed, and yet, curiosity surrounding the mystery of this place enchants brave adventurers and meek souls alike.

Lundum Hills has a dark story all its own to tell, and as the rain gently falls on what remains of a grisly battle, Vashti and Desmond will learn that some stories have a grain of truth in them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30578666/fb5129d4846cfcbb996bc43696e08f484c8bcb9a.gif[/img]
Today, we're sharing a very first look into one of the sub-classes of Arcadian Atlas: [b]The Sorcerer[/b]! Expect the unexpected. To be the ruler of true chaos.

[b]The Sorcerer[/b] is an agent of chaos, taking the practice of magic to dangerous extremes and reveling in the frontlines of war and all the unpredictability that entails. Those specialized in the [b]Wild Magic[/b] branch care nothing for their own safety, pulsing with energy so unhinged it withers their foes while risking their own lives. A Sorcerer trained in the [b]Touch of Death[/b] branch enjoys seeing the life drain from their enemies up-close, laying on hands infused with such concussive magic it obliterates them and leaves those alive utterly debilitated.

This class is perfect for players who like to dabble in chaos. Their ability to touch death and handle wild magic makes them a great choice for those who like to get up close and personal with their foes, or channel their magic from a further distance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30578666/78b895dc4edfc572d6b912ed4b7ac2795f776d7b.png[/img]

King Tirgan, very early in his reign, commissioned one of Dantalion's most capable architects to construct Ryder Lighthouse, a modern marvel still actively guiding ships from harbor to horizons over the expansive sea. Perched atop one of Tropis' most unforgiving cliff sides, this lighthouse was never intended to have tactical value amidst the war ravaged continent, and yet Vashti will find herself taking refuge amidst its light in the course of our story. [h1][b]Arcadian Updates, January 2022[/b][/h1]

[h2]Class Spotlight: Druid[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30578666/967218cfa12911de1867067d542175154340f341.gif[/img]

[h3]An embodiment of nature’s resilience, cunning, and fury, Druids harness the power of nature to create powerful spells. The Druid has become so enmeshed with the natural elements only dreamt of in their Warmancer days that they’re able to create phenomena from nothing. Proficient in Ice, Lightning, and Fire they use these elements to deal damage across the land hitting any enemy unfortunate enough to be in it its path. Druids also have a knack to not only use the elements to create damage but also utilize the earth to create traps. 

While the Druid uses nature to conjure some of the most powerful spells, they are also concerned with ecological balance and like to live in harmony with the nature around them. They are a protector of the lands and garnish respect for the earth they inhabit. You will often see Druids adorned in their light armor and equipped with two-handed staffs.

This class is perfect for players who want to bend the battlefield to their whim, calling forth the earth to trap and decimate their foes.[/h3]


[h1][b]Skin Tone Update:[/b][/h1]

[h3]We are excited to announce that players can now choose between three skin tone choices for ALL core and advanced classes. This allows for more diversity in the world and characters of Arcadia, a goal we've been eager to share with you all and plan to extend to NPCs, shopkeepers and foes![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30578666/ff4b8641fd2e003bdb4c4a84f1ea2000a31c375f.png[/img]

notes.notes:
[h3]This train keeps on rolling right along, and what that means for you is more Arcadian Updates! November's got another map and another class to show off with just a sprinkle of what's to come in the story of Arcadian Atlas, so let's get started, yeah?[/h3]

[h3]Sub-Class Spotlight: Inquisitor[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30578666/f70c38e96049a29ad7a934bbeb72972ac556ff85.gif[/img]

Infused with the power of holy light, Inquisitors are blessed with righteous and vindictive strength. Their unparalleled ability to slay the undead is only matched by their affinity for combating magic users, boasting an incredibly strong Magic Defense (MDEF). Additionally, Inquisitors offer boons and augmentations to their allies by serving as a beacon for their Grand Auras. Those that revel in these auras focus their training in the Aura of Light, turning the area around them into a flood of holy energy that helps and hurts as they choose. There are those, though, that channel their conviction through their bodies, following the path of the Holy Reckoning to mete salvation and justice by their own hand.

Inquisitors are focused on killing magic users of all kinds, with their MDEF providing a strong shielding effect to them as they wade through spells of all elements. This, however, leaves them vulnerable to physical damage, so be sure to keep melee and archers occupied while they wreak havoc in the backline! If your inquisitor is focused in the Aura of Light, keep them just behind your front line so the defenders can have a strong advantage as they hold the line (and occasionally step in to lay down an offensive aura)!

[h3]Map sneak peek:
[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30578666/1d07fc03d6cf25f285c34d6c3f718e5ec002012d.png[/img]

At the foot of the Boultice Mountains rests the Oldwar Triage, a derelict area of respite and healing now becoming overgrown as nature reclaims the area. While the flora come to return the bloodied remains, so do the fauna, and the creatures of Arcadia have grown monstrous and vicious. As war and strife exhaust your party, will the land reclaim them, as well?

Oldwar is a gradual incline, as it sits at the foot of the mountains, but there are steep spaces along the path to position archers and mages, offering your forces an advantage. Make sure your ranged units are safe; open spaces make it easier for melee units to circumvent your front line, and as fragile as they are to physical damage, can be cut down quickly if you're not careful!

As we get into the holidays, the crew will be taking some time off from updates! No worries though, we'll be right back at it with more super cool stuff to show you in the new year! Y'all have a wonderful holiday season, we'll see you soon!

notes.title: Arcadian Updates, October 2021
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello again folks, and welcome to the October 2021 Arcadian Update! The team continues to be hard at work building maps, adding classes, and setting up a whole world full of danger and intrigue! If all that sounds good, keep on reading![/h3]

[h3]Recruitment Center[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30578666/382a73f51bf9ffa74650f709c2e18eb57f09ec6e.png[/img]

Coming to Arcadian Atlas is the ability to recruit new party members! In a war-torn land, building your forces is key, and building your party's composition in a smart way can mean the difference between victory and defeat. At the recruitment center, you're able to choose from a pool of recruits to join your party, determine their class, rename them, and even get some special bonuses! 

Although a pretty and relaxing area, this IS a recruiting ground for fighters from all different walks of life. Fighters? Small space? Nothing could go wrong.

[h3]Sub-Class Spotlight: Monk[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30578666/a600a347c346019c200e3a86fddd2679d2eaa468.gif[/img]

Devoting their lives to rigorous routine and a pure focus on their training, Monks have abilities that can break through the defenses of even the hardiest of foes as well as reshape the battlefield to their advantage. Those that strike hard and fast are dedicated to the way of the Furious Blows, showing unrelenting aggression as their hits deliver a torrent of damage and various debilitating effects, even unto death. Some monks specialize in the mystical ways of the Arcane Energies, providing a versatile set of skills to enhance their party while striking at their enemies from afar.

In a tactical dynamic, Monks are great to have on the frontline alongside other melee classes, as they can gain a quick combat advantage by overwhelming opponents with slow effects and a large amount of damage. At the same time, Monks can also provide a major defensive advantage to other party members close by, establishing zones of protection for your forces and setting up a nigh-impenetrable front to keep enemies engaged!

[h3]Map sneak peek[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30578666/676f31a3fa5d1341b5fb593e2df947908580f45c.png[/img]

In the mountains of Arcadia, Borneano rests as a city positioned on the slopes. Dotted by buildings and paved with walkways to traverse the map, the change in height provides a number of vantage points to rain down on enemies below. For those at the base level, a literal uphill battle awaits; with agile enough party members, the cliffs can be taken quickly, evening out the playing field!



The Twin Otter team's still hard at work developing the winding and arduous story of Arcadian Atlas. We can't wait to show more as time goes on, so stick around as we keep sharing more exciting updates! Until next time!

[h2]Indie Arena Booth Demo & Feedback[/h2]

[previewyoutube=KFVJKK_Suq8;full][/previewyoutube]

ICYMI: We were part of the Indie Arena Booth Steam event last month! There, we were able to share the Arcadian Atlas demo to players everywhere for the very first time, as well as a brand new trailer! We were really excited to see literally thousands of you play the demo and show off your tactical skills (while using Poncho, right? RIGHT????) as you squared up against some challenging encounters  to overcome!

Your feedback has been incredibly helpful in figuring out design decisions the team is working on and considering, including class balancing, battle pacing, overall difficulty, control schemes, and more! We'll be working to implement some of the feedback we've received as we continue working on the game.

[h2]Sub-Class Spotlight: Reaver[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30578666/c6c39839c76a8d4ab1311e66670f1260b28323d2.gif[/img]

Today, we're sharing a very first look into one of the sub-classes of Arcadian Atlas: The Reaver! Watch the shadows, because the shadows are watching you.

Reavers are known for their sudden and relentless strikes on their enemies, unleashing an unexpected onslaught before stealthily slipping away into a hidden state. Those that follow the path of the [b]Dagger Arts[/b] are capable of delivering a flurry of blows using short blades, with each attack inflicting various status effects that cripple their enemies while [b]Hired Assassins[/b] favor precision strikes, dealing massive amounts of damage in one fell swoop and even bending the shadows to serve them.

For fans of the sneaky-stabby methods, Reavers will be your bread and butter. Their high mobility make them the ideal class for closing distances, locking down a specific target to ensure they go down quickly while being able to evade any retaliation. They're not meant to stick around for a stand-up fight, so apply a lot of damage and effects, then get out fast!

[h2]Map sneak peek[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30578666/8313a352f6a58e9f97c314036afe4971e5e4d123.gif[/img]

More beautiful, luscious environments? Is that even possible? (Yes, yes it is.)

This month, we're showing off the Stronghold Outskirts! A seldom-used fortification, the area has fallen into disrepair and dereliction. As nature begins to overtake the ruined stone edifices, what new conflicts will arise on this once-dormant pathway? Where will this path lead, and most importantly, how will you pave the way forward?

Arcadia is a land full of conflict, and that conflict is born from a whole host of ambitions and personal desires. We're excited to continue showing off more as we go along, so stick around and find out just how you can build your party to survive the coming conflict! We'll see you next month!

notes.title: Massive Arcadian Atlas News
notes.notes:
[url=https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-YGY3-EXBj9U/X5CIg5fPKNI/AAAAAAAADOE/PrPk2sUU0coHC-BodZsP7oUefHY0mTNqgCLcBGAsYHQ/s800/squareksupdateimg.png][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-YGY3-EXBj9U/X5CIg5fPKNI/AAAAAAAADOE/PrPk2sUU0coHC-BodZsP7oUefHY0mTNqgCLcBGAsYHQ/s320/squareksupdateimg.png[/img][/url]


First, we want to start out by apologizing for the long interlude between updates and progress reports. It wasn’t for lack of wanting to provide y’all with up-to-date info on the project -- And we are extremely excited to share what we’ve been up to with all of you. 

Thanks to our amazing backers, the Kickstarter campaign afforded us the ability to do all we had promised: 


[list][*][b]A fulltime year of work on Arcadian Atlas covered for Becca[/b][/*][*][b]Full game OST + sound design fees covered[/b][/*][*][b]Programming fees partially covered[/b][/*][*][b]Physical backer item production fees covered [/b][/*][/list]

Going into this, Becca & myself were aware that once the KS-funded dev period was up, we would be taking on day jobs/freelance gigs/contract work to pay the bills and cover the remaining programming fees while we moonlighted as developers for Arcadian Atlas. 


 [img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/031/072/828/e2190d7ffebe2e6b71d87f7f7e8bf1c9_original.gif?ixlib=rb-2.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1603142263&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=bb42006d46380e76911fe74ee3fe9453[/img] 

It was going fine... until about 1.5 years ago, when the team began to take hit after hit, suffering multiple job losses and freelance gig offers drying up. And that was before Covid-19 hit, when the remaining jobs and scant contracts we did have were swallowed up completely. 
 

But this is [u][b]not[/b][/u][b] [/b]a sad update. 
 

We needed to wait until we had 100% solid news (though we drafted an extremely sad update months back in the thick of the worst of it, but we refused to pull the trigger on it). 

Now, after so much fighting for AA, we have an update we actually want to write - with news we really want to bring to y’all. 

After many months & multiple pitches to a handful of talented indie game publishers, video calls and Covid-19 related funding hiccups, we are extremely excited to announce we have partnered with a publisher to cover the final stretch of Arcadian Atlas. 
 

[b][u][i]What does this mean for all y’all folks that believed in us and supported us before anyone else? [/i][/u][/b]

Well... 

[list][*]
[b]The team is now able to develop Arcadian Atlas full time all the way up to release. No day jobs, no contracts, no nothing stealing our focus from the game.[/b]
[/*][*]
[b]Additional platform support![/b]
[/*][*]
[b]A publisher-level QA process means an even smoother experience for the final product.[/b]
[/*][*]
[b]Localization possibilities so we can bring Arcadian Atlas to a much wider audience across the globe![/b]
[/*][*]
[b]Even more we’ve got cooking in the background—like more physical goods than you can shake a stick at![/b]
[/*][*]
[b]Most importantly—a short production timeline. Kickstarter backers that funded the Early Access Beta Tier? The full game? Get ready, because we have further details to come! [/b]
[/*][/list]

We're still working out specific details with the publisher, and we hope to have more details for you all when we can make an official announcement! 
 [img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/031/072/835/b8f5816cb889fff8068aef8d3f5e3f6d_original.gif?ixlib=rb-2.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1603142283&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=f75051de552cc29af932de956d74d4bd[/img] 

To call it a shot of adrenaline for all of us is an understatement, and we’ve got our noses to the grindstone—pumping out animations, character portraits, the programming underpinning it all, and everything else that breathes life into the world of Arcadia—and we can’t wait to share it with you all soon! 

Some much needed good news in the midst of this topsy-turvy world we’ve all found ourselves in. 

In the meantime, let this encourage you to keep fighting for what you’re passionate about. Y’all keep healthy and socially distant, and please be good to each other. We’ll be here fleshing out Arcadia—fully masked, of course! 

Sincerely, 

The Arcadian Atlas Team

notes.title: A New Challenger Approaches
notes.notes:
[url=https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-fjOqB4ElIk0/XIJ9vfNVwhI/AAAAAAAAUTQ/Vrr2f5UblcIgeuXeAidc74x2pIN3Ps01wCLcBGAs/s1600/BloggerMain.gif][img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-fjOqB4ElIk0/XIJ9vfNVwhI/AAAAAAAAUTQ/Vrr2f5UblcIgeuXeAidc74x2pIN3Ps01wCLcBGAs/s320/BloggerMain.gif[/img][/url]Howdy from Texas again, ya'll!
We've got a smorgasbord of new goodies to show off this time around, from new maps, brand-new mapping features that show off the capabilities of the BITE Engine, a new challenger with distant relation to our dearest trash-panda, Poncho, and much more!
Let's dive right in:
[h1][u]A New Challenger Approaches[/u][/h1]Seeing as we named our sweet lil' dude below after our favorite western-wear (and because it's a dang cute name), we wanted to flesh out his move-set with that western bravado we all love so much:[url=https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-PKrIRA3kHpQ/XIJ-VdcMzxI/AAAAAAAAUT8/BnIMdxmiaAMcVjsaQ7CNiPqWsZdJz5XCwCEwYBhgL/s1600/PonchoStab.gif][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-PKrIRA3kHpQ/XIJ-VdcMzxI/AAAAAAAAUT8/BnIMdxmiaAMcVjsaQ7CNiPqWsZdJz5XCwCEwYBhgL/s1600/PonchoStab.gif[/img][/url]

  But there's a classic western song Becca and I love by Willie & Merle, Pancho & Lefty, and we thought, you know... Poncho needs a buddy. Sooooo, without further ado, a new challenger approaches![url=https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-D9GbVTajcDY/XIJ-UZBAlMI/AAAAAAAAUTs/gGhRvjghksIU0smbzH8-MFZp6ui4RvASQCEwYBhgL/s1600/LeftyWalkCycle.gif][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-D9GbVTajcDY/XIJ-UZBAlMI/AAAAAAAAUTs/gGhRvjghksIU0smbzH8-MFZp6ui4RvASQCEwYBhgL/s1600/LeftyWalkCycle.gif[/img][/url]
  Lefty is a Red Panda, and while hailing from a distant and mysterious land, he's come to have a classic western showdown with our pal Poncho. And watch out when he swings that big stick of his, cause bamboo doesn't bend or break easily.[url=https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-fYMDWi6XS8Q/XIJ-UokE3nI/AAAAAAAAUUQ/dUTp6PoR50MURx4AcyoZpOIjRss37G9hQCEwYBhgL/s1600/LeftyAttack.gif][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-fYMDWi6XS8Q/XIJ-UokE3nI/AAAAAAAAUUQ/dUTp6PoR50MURx4AcyoZpOIjRss37G9hQCEwYBhgL/s1600/LeftyAttack.gif[/img][/url]
   And with all this work on our furry friends, we haven't neglected some of those small touches that give our other characters life, with some custom animations like Fennic's below:[url=https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-TI_KV86lwl8/XIJ-TTPu2kI/AAAAAAAAUUc/XbVW7GD4upYmDvz1OwuOB0XpxR2MY5CLgCEwYBhgL/s1600/FennicSauve.gif][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-TI_KV86lwl8/XIJ-TTPu2kI/AAAAAAAAUUc/XbVW7GD4upYmDvz1OwuOB0XpxR2MY5CLgCEwYBhgL/s1600/FennicSauve.gif[/img][/url]

[h1][u]BITE Feature Expansion - Mapping[/u][/h1]And with all this work on animations, Patrick's been hard at work expanding the Map Editor Features of BITE, like the new ability to customize key mappings for all the Editor's features. So whether you're more comfortable with the Arrow Keys or WASD, he's got you covered:[url=https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-VBhgFY52mBk/XIJ-UJeMR5I/AAAAAAAAUUY/mM_LkyEUFXAxdJefl0CfwyheY5f8XwfpgCEwYBhgL/s1600/KeyControls.png][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-VBhgFY52mBk/XIJ-UJeMR5I/AAAAAAAAUUY/mM_LkyEUFXAxdJefl0CfwyheY5f8XwfpgCEwYBhgL/s1600/KeyControls.png[/img][/url]

And building maps ain't easy, so he's added new brushes from a single-tile, four-tile and fill brush to quickly cover more ground![url=https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-vwlGvmSLxJg/XIJ-WYgngHI/AAAAAAAAUUg/AIPuPgaFN_830TxVgsIhjm0Bz3Vq2MbSgCEwYBhgL/s1600/TileBrushes.gif][img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-vwlGvmSLxJg/XIJ-WYgngHI/AAAAAAAAUUg/AIPuPgaFN_830TxVgsIhjm0Bz3Vq2MbSgCEwYBhgL/s1600/TileBrushes.gif[/img][/url]

But my favorite new feature is the simple Impasse System, which allows you to designate individual tiles that are impassable, leaving the control completely in the creators hands as to how maps are navigated. Plus, it looks beautiful:[url=https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-IUiZSd74tjA/XIJ-U_UyhrI/AAAAAAAAUUY/zWm5WjYDQroBIJpeNIUGgUdUWXCFtaN5QCEwYBhgL/s1600/Impasse-System.gif][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-IUiZSd74tjA/XIJ-U_UyhrI/AAAAAAAAUUY/zWm5WjYDQroBIJpeNIUGgUdUWXCFtaN5QCEwYBhgL/s1600/Impasse-System.gif[/img][/url]

We've already gone through and added these impasses to our existing maps, spreading the love as you can see below:[url=https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-4KGPj27vGv8/XIJ-VWupYfI/AAAAAAAAUUc/inOasxvnmBk0ym9rzBBjuCpMNp4FmMHMgCEwYBhgL/s1600/MapCycle.gif][img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-4KGPj27vGv8/XIJ-VWupYfI/AAAAAAAAUUc/inOasxvnmBk0ym9rzBBjuCpMNp4FmMHMgCEwYBhgL/s1600/MapCycle.gif[/img][/url]

And we've worked up a few new places for you to cause havoc, like these alternate, fighting-enabled interiors:[url=https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-jO9pSHJVpck/XIJ-VYixZjI/AAAAAAAAUUU/bRtrksSWsrkiN9QvS9859dpPVEVBIN6FACEwYBhgL/s1600/RecruitmentCenter.png][img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-jO9pSHJVpck/XIJ-VYixZjI/AAAAAAAAUUU/bRtrksSWsrkiN9QvS9859dpPVEVBIN6FACEwYBhgL/s1600/RecruitmentCenter.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-69ym9kggVYA/XIJ-V2-iglI/AAAAAAAAUUg/5DiOaohcvhImrXa8SE02qm040n3lb9UlACEwYBhgL/s1600/Tavern.png][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-69ym9kggVYA/XIJ-V2-iglI/AAAAAAAAUUg/5DiOaohcvhImrXa8SE02qm040n3lb9UlACEwYBhgL/s1600/Tavern.png[/img][/url]

Oh, and did we mention we're hard at work on a new biome: the desert! That perfect place for Poncho and Lefty to square off in, especially if a tumbleweed blows through:[url=https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-HE7CY4Bty38/XIJ-TGNl06I/AAAAAAAAUUU/qVqtOsomEiQmbq5UblbzqmoUagHGs5RhQCEwYBhgL/s1600/DesertBiome.png][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-HE7CY4Bty38/XIJ-TGNl06I/AAAAAAAAUUU/qVqtOsomEiQmbq5UblbzqmoUagHGs5RhQCEwYBhgL/s1600/DesertBiome.png[/img][/url]

[h1][u]BITE Feature Expansion - Cutscene Editor[/u][/h1]And these improvements from BITE are already filtering into the Cutscene Editor, which Patrick is engineering to include streamlined event re-ordering, actor additions, and a whole slew of visual tweaks that we've got previews of below:[url=https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-XErtkklOpJ4/XIJ-TPeVKpI/AAAAAAAAUUU/X-9Z8o-7F4kEz4t3j6in_IaMgSaGt9X2QCEwYBhgL/s1600/Cutscene%2BEditor%2BData%2BDriven%2BView.png][img]https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-XErtkklOpJ4/XIJ-TPeVKpI/AAAAAAAAUUU/X-9Z8o-7F4kEz4t3j6in_IaMgSaGt9X2QCEwYBhgL/s1600/Cutscene%2BEditor%2BData%2BDriven%2BView.png[/img][/url]

We're excited to show off the practical in-game implications of this next time!
[h1][u]Until Next Time, Yeeeehaaaaw[/u][/h1]I guess the desert tiles are bringing out the country in me, but we've only just begun with these and another exciting biome we've got in the works:[url=https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-57AF3o3a0lk/XIJ-S6tGfmI/AAAAAAAAUUc/eHF8Z1zpdyIZieJcJGxtghwt0NR4uIb4ACEwYBhgL/s1600/ComingUp.png][img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-57AF3o3a0lk/XIJ-S6tGfmI/AAAAAAAAUUc/eHF8Z1zpdyIZieJcJGxtghwt0NR4uIb4ACEwYBhgL/s1600/ComingUp.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Update 13: BITE Engine, Iconography, Streaming Art & More!
notes.notes:
Welcome back adventurers! We've got some awesome news this go-round for not just backers, but creators, so keep your eyes peeled.

But before we jump in, if you've ever wanted to see the artistry behind Arcadian Atlas live, soon you can! Becca and I have worked to get a Twitch stream set up where you can watch her live-stream art creation, from maptiles, character design, animation work, and more!


[url=https://www.twitch.tv/tupeloshoney][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30578666/199ab96d695a928e7f7e9cd239ca6e3ce5bbdce1.png[/img][/url]

[b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/tupeloshoney]Give her a follow[/url][/b] and keep your eyes peeled for her first live stream announcement. For more info & polls on things like preferred stream times, check out her twitter page here.

[b][h1]Introducing: The BITE Engine[/h1][/b]
Way back when we jumped from RPG Maker to the more expansive world of Unity, we had a vision for not just our dream game, but for a creation tool so user-friendly it could be given to anyone who wanted to make a tactical RPG (one of the most notoriously difficult genres to create).

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1266693296/arcadian-atlas-tactical-rpg-inspired-by-classics/posts/2264527][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30578666/bb8594420b3b1db392ec1f17e8a22df5ac0455c0.gif[/img][/url]

That dream is beginning to become a reality concurrently with the creation of Arcadian Atlas. Patrick has been hard-at-work on the foundation for what we are dubbing the BITE engine enhancement - an add-on that utilizes Odin Inspector's tools to create easily-modifiable units, scenarios, skills, items, weapons, and scenes. The best part: this tool is being developed in conjunction with Atlas, meaning every benefit to the system is a benefit to the game, which includes the following:

More Power to the Game Designer - A large portion of a game designer's life is turning knobs and whistles to balance values and to create the best possible experience for the player. You've all probably played RPGs with horrid difficulty spikes, or gotten bored going hours without a challenge. BITE allows us to easily and quickly implement your feedback when it comes beta time!


[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1266693296/arcadian-atlas-tactical-rpg-inspired-by-classics/posts/2264527][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30578666/bc63c0d1b418a38244f454248607ef8e9341ee41.gif[/img][/url]
BITE Engine's Weapon Editor

Smaller File and Patch Sizes - To get Arcadian Atlas' prototype off the ground, we initially utilized Unity Prefabs. Moving to a new different segmented form of data means we can be much more efficient with the size of the game, as well as any patches we make on Steam (and elsewhere). We know some of you backers have internet data caps, so we want to keep file sizes as user-friendly as possible!

Advanced Cutscenes and Scenarios - We've forged a giant pyramid of stats, classes, status effects, and skills out of the prototype's design work so far. Cutscenes and scenarios (missions) rely on pretty much everything, so being clean and organized with those building blocks allows us to quickly create, reorder, and modify events.

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1266693296/arcadian-atlas-tactical-rpg-inspired-by-classics/posts/2264527][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30578666/47d6906ab4f73b12d69de50af1c06222ecfb24f0.gif[/img][/url]
BITE Engine's Core Editor

Plug & Play Capabilities - We've re-structured the logic and data to separate it from the graphics, which is a fancy way of saying Arcadian Atlas and future tactical RPGs using BITE will require far less digging into code-bases to create and play!

Effortless Changes - With BITE's data-driven design, we can remove, add, and change everything from units, status effects, skills, missions, locations, cutscenes (or most anything else) effortlessly midway through development based on new needs and feedback!

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1266693296/arcadian-atlas-tactical-rpg-inspired-by-classics/posts/2264527][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30578666/47b94df1f42b6aadd5050d178c95ce492020086e.gif[/img][/url]
BITE Engine's Unit Editor

[b][h1]Iconic[/h1][/b]
To celebrate BITE, we wanted to show off some of the graphics we're paring with Patrick's data-driven systems.

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1266693296/arcadian-atlas-tactical-rpg-inspired-by-classics/posts/2264527][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30578666/5ba6e932049badc35eb884015f28c99a6cfc4f22.gif[/img][/url]
Menu and Stat Icons

Iconography is an integral part of the user experience, and serves both as localization tool (because images require no translation) and ease of navigation. We love the design challenge of creating icons for our stats, items, text boxes, and menus that are at the same time simple, clean, and communicate efficiently. See below just a handful of those we've cooked up for our items:

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1266693296/arcadian-atlas-tactical-rpg-inspired-by-classics/posts/2264527][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30578666/224c900b43ee5787ad2fb4a40b4b0e3573305e7a.gif[/img][/url]
Item Icons


[b][h1]Interior Designs & Graphics Galore[/h1][/b]
And of course behind the scenes we've been hard at work on all the graphics, from animations, items, and some drool-worthy interiors. You'll show yourself outside? Why not show yourself INSIDE you reckless warriors!

This go round Becca has been working up some graphics for house interiors and our Recruitment Centers throughout Arcadia. You can see a few of these below.

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1266693296/arcadian-atlas-tactical-rpg-inspired-by-classics/posts/2264527][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30578666/1f30612b1173087cbd12b8f2b5ba156c0f000121.png[/img][/url]
Recruiter Maptiles

And if we zoom in a bit you can see some light pouring through new windows, and  bench for troops to sit and wait (because isn't a Recruitment Center just a glorified waiting room) , and a fancy desk for processing new troops.

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1266693296/arcadian-atlas-tactical-rpg-inspired-by-classics/posts/2264527][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30578666/b63f5990c8ebb912c391f324859596f2b66f9a6a.png[/img][/url]
Interior Details

Of course, when you're not waiting, you're training with some quality practice dummies and an assortment of weaponry for our discerning warriors:

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1266693296/arcadian-atlas-tactical-rpg-inspired-by-classics/posts/2264527][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30578666/9a44387bbc57068af7815cfdeb48f8745466655f.png[/img][/url]
Interior Details Cont'd

And when you're ready to lay your sweet head to rest, we've got a deluxe bed you could probably cram a couple of people in (uncomfortably, but this isn't a charity!) and some barrels full of wine to help the long hours seem short.

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1266693296/arcadian-atlas-tactical-rpg-inspired-by-classics/posts/2264527][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30578666/517c7a374997da38110cf11c9fdc9ef50847f295.png[/img][/url]

Oh, and not zoomed in on is that lil' cactus. Because we might be thrifty interior designers, but we're not animals. Get some greenery in there!

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1266693296/arcadian-atlas-tactical-rpg-inspired-by-classics/posts/2264527][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30578666/0eab5126a0aab39c08033135eaf35395932e3ed1.gif[/img][/url]
Crossbow Animations

We're also putting finishing touches on our primary attack animations, ensuring all eight frames front and back are as smooth as possible. From the heavy crossbow toting Ranger above, to the gargantuan hammer our Apothecary is dragging around below, we're nearly done with all our CORE classes and their various fightin' styles!

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1266693296/arcadian-atlas-tactical-rpg-inspired-by-classics/posts/2264527][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30578666/7c946769014840c1536d1dfb2df8f9b62c6cbeb0.gif[/img][/url]
Hammer Animations

And of course a whole slew of new items for our re-vamped BITE enabled item editors!

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1266693296/arcadian-atlas-tactical-rpg-inspired-by-classics/posts/2264527][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30578666/2a79b86ce6f5fc0b7ced1ec97b6731204a4969d2.gif[/img][/url]

[b][h1]Next Time[/h1][/b]
We're excited to show off some of the interior maps we're working up with these shiny new graphics, the expanded Skill sections of BITE, and lots more art next time! Be sure to check out Becca's Twitch streams and our twitter pages for up-to-the-moment previews and sneak-peaks!

Until then, keep your controllers warm and your bodies cool as we end out this record-setting summer heat!

~Taylor

notes.title: Kickstarter Update 12: Anatomy of Animation, Map Efficiency, and More!
notes.notes:
[h1]Update 12: Anatomy of Animation, Map Efficiency, and More![/h1]
 
Welcome all you wonderful folks to another action-packed episode of Arcadian Atlas! This time around we've got tons of details from all across the game development spectrum. Whether it be animation, portraits, map-tunage, music, or behind-the-scenes on programming - you're in the right place!

So dive on in. The waters are warm and cozy!


[h1][u]Anatomy of Animation[/u][/h1]

Artistically, animation is the most pain-staking process of game development. It's a multilayered art, both literally and figuratively, and we wanted to give you a peak behind that process in more depth as we finalize the animations for our core classes.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30578666/788c9fd64ee6a1d142ef52413a19a4dba7e589b4.png[/img]

Each core class has a list of essential battle animations, arranged in a sheet, that are consistent across classes. What's not consistent across classes? Attacks & Skills.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30578666/4126f40c40c2fc21dfd7cf7018f236dbf8a3047f.gif[/img]

So when making new animations, we start with real-world examples and build keyframes from them. In the case of the above Apothecary Bottle Throw animation, I used myself as a base and built from it.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30578666/0fee1ebc3074b549b1d869d564ce3ea1a0cedb12.gif[/img]

New animations typically work in stages:

Raw Footage - a video or gif of real-world people performing the action to be animated.
Skeleton - the basic shapes of an animation, typically very rough. This is used to ensure the flow of the animation looks correct before detail is added.
Naked Base - the naked form all classes can use before hair, clothes, and other details are added.
Clothed - usually the final stage where all class-specific content is added to the naked base and added to that core classes' sprite sheet.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30578666/c92e6ad0302e6dc17d99fc26c8adada52f433c59.gif[/img]

So in essence, any new animation we create is actually 3 animations, and from start to finish with the Apothecary Bottle Throw it looks like the example below:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30578666/7e50b4512e611ce71b16cf8137e833174f933029.gif[/img]

And that's just the specialized animations! We've got a whole slew of basic movements and actions to tackle.

[h1][u]Back to Basics[/u][/h1]

Ah, the essentials of a fight. We've got our Idling, Walking, Injured, Charging, Jumping, Flying, Landing, Death animations, and the list goes on! And remember, that's for front views, back views, male, and female troops. 48+ unique frames per class, 2 genders, 4 classes - that's 384+ unique frames just for basic animations!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30578666/e347f3a0e1e612c97d6d4e213176478ccb9d0ff5.gif[/img]

Over the last few months we've been steadily chipping away at them, and we're happy to say we've not only finalized the designs for our male/female Apothecary and male/female Warmancer - but we've even knocked out all of their core animations! Yep, all 384+ of them!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30578666/277a559e3632958c0dd3e8afac3a7dad987c1e8e.gif[/img]

And now we move on to the specialized attacks for each class, one of which Becca's been hard at work on below:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30578666/c16f40348ff4695232391784c4e5c0d1f79d816e.gif[/img]

[h1][u]Serving Fierce Face[/u][/h1]

Let's face it (see what I did there?): little Apothecary and Warmancer sprites are super cute, but sometimes we need to look a person square in the high-detailed eye and give them a good talkin' to.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30578666/de7b4cb8823e7f056f8a373ea64945544b52ec43.gif[/img]

So Becca and I have been hard at work on portraits to go with our sprites. Because there's nothing sadder than walking into a tavern and the tavern-master won't even look you in the face. That's enough reason to brawl right then and there!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30578666/7f4433d84c7a2c9cf7355378e5b473fcae862fef.gif[/img]

[h1][u]Improvements Abound with Odin[/u][/h1]

And as pretty as these lil' dudes are walking, slapping, and smashing about - a video game has to be as efficient as possible. Patrick recently upgraded our Unity build with  Odin Inspector, a powerful tool that's allowed him to streamline how maps, cutscenes, and menus save data and juggle database information.

We've gone from complicated and rather ugly excel files for items to completely in-engine databases with images and separate, easy-to-read and alter fields like this:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30578666/05ad86c6bd2ee08dda09023ea2f3be29e8c0a0c3.gif[/img]

But it's not just for databases! Odin has far-reaching implications for space saving, with the potential to reduce both disk and RAM space requirements by upwards of 90%! That's huge for download size and run speed! In fact, we're already applying it to how maps are constructed and saved:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30578666/b0f632bb200125f21b80ad996963a94ed0aec0f8.png[/img]

So while we absolutely adore the animations and art side of Arcadian Atlas, this is easily what is making us most happy!

Oh, but we forgot that we're even improving how animations are handled in the background ; ). Blend Trees will allow us to better organize all of our isometric animations within Unity so that we can finish hooking it up to our unique characters and classes faster! Possibly 75% faster! NUMBERS! BIG NUMBERS EVERYWHERE!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30578666/8120e0eda5576ce2cfea0a5f7752329ee04733f3.gif[/img]

[h1][u]Tavern Tunes[/u][/h1]

But wait, there's more! We wanted to serenade you out with the latest tune Moritz is working up for our tavern patrons. Because if there's one thing you want while getting a bit tipsy (or enjoying a nice virgin piña colada perhaps?) it's some jazzy tunes:

[url=https://d15chbti7ht62o.cloudfront.net/assets/021/344/243/2e899e5b247c8c93a65266cfc4244fb2_mp3.mp3][h1][b][i]Tavern Theme Song[/i][/b][/h1][/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30578666/2895887105cb4c0704d8b00dbff8c144ba611993.png[/img]

Oh, and why not grab a contract to smash some more things while you're at it?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30578666/2508999ee6b41c485e84a984915443e6ff7f8f9e.png[/img]

[h1][u]Speeding Into Summer[/u][/h1]


That's it for now, but keep your eyes peeled on our twitter page for glimpses of what's coming up in the Arcadian Atlas pipeline as we get closer to beta!

[b][i][url=https://twitter.com/ArcadianAtlas]Arcadian Atlas Twitter[/url][/i][/b]

And we'll see all you crazy kids next time with juicy details of skills, fighting' poses, menus, and all the clockwork that makes this beauty tick!
